inlines.v: GOUGE, noun gouj. A round hollow chisel, used to cut holes, channels or grooves in wood or stone. GOUGE, verb transitive gouj. To scoop out with a gouge 1. To force out the eye of a person with the thumb or finger; a barbarous practice.
